lines.text: Because the famine was severe, Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while.
Before entering Egypt, Abram asked his wife Sarai to say she was his sister so he would be spared.
Pharaoh's officials saw Sarai, commended her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.
Pharaoh treated Abram well and he acquired animals and servants, but the LORD afflicted Pharaoh with severe famines.
Pharaoh summoned Abram and asked why he said Sarai was his sister, so that Pharaoh took her as his servant.
